sections.title: 一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 完形填空 (每小题2分, 共20分)
sections.passage:
Every country has different kinds of flowers. Plum blossom is a kind of beautiful flower in China. What's more, plum blossom is one of the Chinese top ten famous flowers. Plum blossom is very [1] to us Chinese because of its history and cultural meaning.

Plum blossom first [2] in the south of China around the Yangtze River, dating back (追溯到) 3,000 years. From ancient China till now, people have always [3] plum blossom to have two roles—one is an important business plant, and the other is an ornamental (观赏的) plant. Later, it was brought in Japan, Korea and Vietnam.

More importantly, we love plum blossom also because of its [4] cultural meaning. First, this kind of flower has five petals (花瓣). It stands for [5] , good luck and long life. It can also stand for safety and peace. Second, all the other flowers [6] live when heavy snow covers the world. However, only plum trees stand straight up, and proudly bloom (开花) in rich colors in such [7] days. They bring people the news of [8] spring. So the plum blossom not only means courage, strong will (意志力) and hope, but also represents (代表) beauty and new life. Third, it plays an important [9] in Chinese literature. It is often praised in Chinese poetry and art. In a word, [10] plum blossom has a long history, it is very special to the Chinese.

questions.translation: 梅花对我们中国人来说非常重要，因为它的历史和文化意义。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文，梅花在中国文化中地位很高，因此对中国人来说是很重要的。important意为“重要的”，符合语境。
questions.prompt: Plum blossom is very 1 to us Chinese

questions.translation: 梅花最初出现在中国南方长江流域，可追溯到3000年前。
questions.explanation: appear意为“出现”，符合植物起源的语境。
questions.prompt: Plum blossom first 2 in the south of China

questions.translation: 从古代到现代，人们一直认为梅花具有两个角色……
questions.explanation: consider... to have...意为“认为……具有……”，符合搭配。
questions.prompt: people have always 3 plum blossom to have two roles

questions.translation: 我们喜爱梅花，更因为其深刻的文化意义。
questions.explanation: deep意为“深刻的”，修饰文化意义恰当。
questions.prompt: because of its 4 cultural meaning

questions.translation: 它象征着幸福、好运和长寿。
questions.explanation: happiness意为“幸福”，与good luck和long life并列，符合吉祥的寓意。
questions.prompt: It stands for 5 , good luck and long life

questions.translation: 第二，当大雪覆盖世界时，所有其他花朵都无法存活。
questions.explanation: cannot表示客观能力或可能性的否定，意为“不能”。
questions.prompt: all the other flowers 6 live when heavy snow covers the world

questions.translation: 然而，只有梅树在如此漫天大雪的日子里挺直身躯……
questions.explanation: 前文提到heavy snow（大雪），因此这里指“下雪的”日子，即snowy。
questions.prompt: in such 7 days

questions.translation: 它们给人们带来了早春的消息。
questions.explanation: 早春时节梅花傲雪怒放，因此是早春（early spring）的消息。
questions.prompt: The news of 8 spring

questions.translation: 第三，它在中国文学中扮演着重要的角色。
questions.explanation: play an important role意为“扮演重要角色”，是固定搭配。
questions.prompt: it plays an important 9 in Chinese literature

questions.translation: 总之，尽管梅花有着悠久的历史，它对中国人来说非常特别。
questions.explanation: although引导让步状语从句，意为“尽管”。
questions.prompt: In a word, 10 plum blossom has a long history

sections.title: 二、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读理解 (每小题4分, 共28分)
sections.passage:
A

Just as soil (土壤) provides energy for trees, a substrate (基质) works the same way for mushrooms. Farmers traditionally used wood to make the substrate, which hurts the environment. But now, thanks to China's "Juncao" (菌草) technology, fewer trees are cut down to do this. Juncao is a grass that can grow up to 8 meters tall. To grow the mushrooms, people first collect the grass and make it into powder (粉末). Then, they mix the powder with water and other things to make the substrate. It helps mushrooms grow quickly. Later on, people can eat the mushrooms or sell them.

This "magical" grass has become a popular plant in Africa. After being brought there, Juncao has helped many people live a better life. For example, in Rwanda, thousands of families are planting Juncao for a living. Thanks to it, many of these families are making much more money than before.

Besides helping grow mushrooms, Juncao has many other things to offer. It can be turned into hardboard strong enough to make buildings. It is also good food for animals, like cows and sheep. What's more, Juncao can help solve environmental problems. Its deep roots (根) help make the soil stronger. When it rains, there is less chance of the soil being washed away.

B

Dog lovers agree that dogs are loyal (忠诚的) and loving pets. They greet their owners excitedly and offer comfort during difficult times. Cats, however, are often seen as more independent (独立的). They may seem to show attention mainly when they want food or play. There is a funny saying. It says, "Dogs have owners; cats have employees (雇员)." This makes us wonder who chooses to become "a cat's employee".

There are stereotypes (刻板印象) about pet owners. "Cat people" are often thought to be more independent and a little unusual, while "dog people" are seen as friendly and easy to stay with in our minds. Psychologist Sam Gosling from the University of Texas studied these ideas. The researchers (研究人员) found that cat owners liked spending time alone better. They were often more curious and creative. Dog owners, on the other hand, were usually more outgoing, energetic, relaxed and loyal.

[ 16 ] They found users who posted pictures of dogs had more online friends and shared more happy feelings, like being proud and excited. Cat owners were more likely to be single and sometimes shared feelings of being tired or sad. However, they also showed more intellectual (智力的) interests. They liked to search more pages about books, TV shows, movies and fantasy stories.

It's important to remember that there are also exceptions—some cat owners are very outgoing, and some dog owners are worriers. People probably choose pets that match their personalities (性格). It makes sense for a quiet person to choose a cat, and an active person to choose a dog. But the change might go both ways. The pet might also shape the owner's life. As Gosling notes, a shy dog owner might not become the life of the party, but their daily walks could lead to more conversations with neighbors.

questions.translation: 关于用菌草制作的基质，哪一项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段内容，传统用木头做基质会破坏环境，而使用菌草技术可以少砍树，因此菌草基质对环境是友好的。选项D正确。
questions.prompt: Which is true about the substrate made from Juncao?
options: It is strong to make buildings.
It is friendly to the environment.

questions.translation: 作者是如何展示菌草在非洲很受欢迎的？
questions.explanation: 第二段中作者通过举例说明（For example, in Rwanda...），证明菌草在非洲很受欢迎并帮助人们过上更好的生活。
questions.prompt: How does the writer show Juncao is popular in Africa?

questions.translation: 这篇文章主要向我们讲述了关于菌草的什么？
questions.explanation: 文章全面介绍了菌草作为蘑菇基质、在非洲的应用以及制作硬板、喂养动物、保护土壤等多方面的作用，即它的优势。选项B正确。
questions.prompt: What does the text mainly tell us about Juncao?

questions.translation: 划线部分“Dogs have owners; cats have employees”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 前文提到狗对主人非常忠诚热烈，而猫更独立，只有在需要食物或玩耍时才理睬主人。幽默地说“狗有主人，猫有雇员”，意思是猫不像狗那样依赖人类，故选项D符合题意。
questions.prompt: What does the underlined part "Dogs have owners; cats have employees" mean?
options: Dogs and cats are both the most popular pets.
Cats usually listen to their owners but dogs don't.
Humans should work for both dogs and cats.
Cats don't depend on owners as much as dogs.

questions.translation: Sam Gosling关于猫主人发现了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“The researchers found that cat owners liked spending time alone better. They were often more curious and creative.”可知，猫主人喜欢独处且更具创造力。
questions.prompt: What did Sam Gosling find about cat owners?
options: They were more energetic in their daily life.
They were worried about almost all of the things.
They enjoyed staying alone and were more creative.
They liked staying with others and were more curious.

questions.translation: 第三段的空白处“[ 16 ]”填入哪句话最合适？
questions.explanation: 第三段首句缺少过渡，紧接着下文提到“They found users who posted pictures of dogs...”，说明研究人员利用了社交媒体来进行研究。选项C切合语境。
questions.prompt: Which sentence is the most suitable for the blank "[ 16 ]" in Paragraph 3?
options: Many people like sharing pet photos on social media.
Dogs and cats are the most ordinary pets for people.
Researchers also used social media to study the subject.
Social media is popular among young people nowadays.

questions.translation: 作者可能会赞同以下哪种观点？
questions.explanation: 最后一段指出“The pet might also shape the owner's life”，说明宠物和主人可以互相改变。选项A符合作者观点。
questions.prompt: Which idea might the writer agree with?
options: Pets and their owners can change each other.
Pets cannot change their owners' lives at all.
Those stereotypes about pet owners are correct all the time.
Dog owners are too busy walking dogs to talk with neighbors.

sections.title: 三、语法填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文, 在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage:
Shanghai Zoo's tiger enclosure (围场) is packed with visitors, and it's all thanks to [18] (a) cute female Bengal tiger named Hong Tang or Brown Sugar. Born in August 2024, this little tiger has become the [19] (popular) animal in the zoo. Thousands of people come every day just to see her, including tourists from other [20] (place)! Many visitors say she looks like a big golden cat because she is [21] (play) and has a sweet face. Visitors love buying things like cards and cushions (垫子) with her picture on them. But Brown Sugar isn't just pretty. She's super friendly to humans because of her special story. Her mom [22] (leave) her when she was born, so zookeepers raised her. Thanks to their care, she grew up. Now she loves showing herself off to visitors.

In October, the zoo moved her to a [23] (big) home, so she has more space to play. Volunteers helped make her new home comfortable. They cleaned up her new home and added fun things for [24] (she) to climb on and explore. "This isn't just about making animals happy—it shows that humans and animals can be good friends," said Xu Feng, a volunteer. Like the pandas of Sichuan, Brown Sugar is one of China's new "animal celebrities (动物明星)". Photos and videos of her are shared online [25] (quick). They attract more visitors to Shanghai Zoo and teach people why it's important [26] (save) animals in danger. Everyone [27] (hope) this will help save animals.

questions.translation: 多亏了一只名叫红糖或布朗尼的可爱雌性孟加拉虎。
questions.explanation: 此处泛指“一只”可爱的孟加拉虎，cute以辅音音素开头，故用不定冠词a。
questions.prompt: thanks to [18] cute female Bengal tiger

questions.translation: 这只小老虎成为了动物园里最受欢迎的动物。
questions.explanation: 前面有the修饰，应用形容词最高级most popular。
questions.prompt: become the [19] animal in the zoo

questions.translation: 包括来自其他地方的游客！
questions.explanation: other后接可数名词复数，place的复数形式为places。
questions.prompt: tourists from other [20]

questions.translation: 许多游客说她看起来像一只大金猫，因为她很爱玩且长着一张甜美的脸。
questions.explanation: 系动词is后接形容词作表语，play的形容词形式为playful（爱玩的）。
questions.prompt: because she is [21] and has a sweet face

questions.translation: 当她出生时，她的妈妈抛弃了她，所以动物园管理员养育了她。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文及born可知，动作发生在过去，应用一般过去时，leave的过去式为left。
questions.prompt: Her mom [22] her when she was born

questions.translation: 十月份，动物园把她搬到了一处更大的家……
questions.explanation: 根据语境，搬到一个“更大”的家，应用形容词比较级bigger。
questions.prompt: moved her to a [23] home

questions.translation: 他们清理了她的新家，并为她添加了好玩的东西供她攀爬和探索。
questions.explanation: 介词for后接人称代词宾格形式she的宾格为her。
questions.prompt: added fun things for [24] to climb on

questions.translation: 关于她的照片和视频在网上被迅速分享。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词are shared应用副词，quick的副词形式为quickly。
questions.prompt: shared online [25]

questions.translation: 并且教导人们为什么拯救处于危险中的动物是重要的。
questions.explanation: 句型It is important to do sth.，应用动词不定式to save。
questions.prompt: why it's important [26] animals in danger

questions.translation: 每个人都希望这会有助于拯救动物。
questions.explanation: everyone作主语时，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式hopes。
questions.prompt: Everyone [27] this will help save animals

sections.title: 四、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文, 回答短文后的问题。(前3题每题答案不超过10个词)
sections.passage:
It was morning, and the new sun was shining gold across the gentle sea. A crowd of a thousand seagulls (海鸥) were fighting for bits of food. But far away from these birds, Jonathan Seagull was practicing flying alone. Most seagulls don't trouble themselves to learn more than the simplest facts of flight—how to get food and come back. For most seagulls, it is not flying that matters, but eating. For this seagull, however, flight is much more important than eating. More than anything else, Jonathan Seagull loved to fly.

This kind of thinking, he found, is not the way to make oneself popular with other birds. Even his parents were unhappy.

"See here, Jonathan," said his father not unkindly. "Winter isn't far away. If you don't study how to get food, you might die of hunger in the future. Flying is all very well, but you can't eat flight, you know."

Jonathan understood what his father meant. For the next few days he tried to act like the other seagulls; he really tried, screaming and fighting with other seagulls for fish and bread. But he couldn't make it work.

"It's all so worthless (没有价值的)," he thought. "I could be spending all this time learning to fly. There's so much to learn!"

It wasn't long before Jonathan Seagull was off by himself again, far out at sea, hungry, happy, learning. The subject was speed, and in a week's practice he learned more about speed than the fastest seagull alive.

questions.translation: 乔纳森·海鸥最喜欢做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“More than anything else, Jonathan Seagull loved to fly.”可知，他最喜欢飞行。选项B正确。
questions.prompt: What did Jonathan Seagull like doing most?

questions.translation: 父亲说“you can't eat flight”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 父亲意在提醒他飞行不能当饭吃，生存和食物同样重要，不能只顾飞行而不管觅食。选项C正确。
questions.prompt: What did Father mean by saying "you can't eat flight"?
options: Food is less important than flying.
Flying cannot be used as food for living.
Seagulls should not learn how to fly.

questions.translation: 乔纳森对与其他鸟类争夺食物有什么看法？
questions.explanation: 根据第五段“'It's all so worthless,' he thought. 'I could be spending all this time learning to fly.'”可知，他认为这毫无价值。选项A正确。
questions.prompt: What did Jonathan think of fighting with others for food?

questions.translation: 你认为乔纳森最终会挨饿至死吗？为什么或为什么不是？
questions.explanation: 根据文章内容，乔纳森虽然追求飞行，但他也懂得学习和追求自己的梦想，并且在不断成长，因此他不会挨饿。选项C符合积极的主题。
questions.prompt: Do you think Jonathan will die of hunger finally? Why or why not?
options: Yes, because he doesn't know how to catch fish at all.
Yes, because he refuses to talk with his parents.
No, because his passion for flying and learning will lead him to success.
No, because other seagulls will share their food with him.
